mapper.select: SELECT * FROM department WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY parent_id, sort
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO department (name, code, parent_id, leader, phone, sort, status, is_deleted, create_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{code}, #{parentId}, #{leader}, #{phone}, #{sort}, #{status}, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE department SET name = #{name}, code = #{code}, parent_id = #{parentId}, leader = #{leader}, phone = #{phone}, sort = #{sort}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
